_comment: Single source of truth for run_urban_workflows.ps1 and verify_repository_health.py. Paths are repo-root-relative. 'env' names a conda environment under %USERPROFILE%/anaconda3/envs (override with -PythonExe). 'training: true' targets refuse to run without -AllowTraining (this gate also covers heavy inference). 'defaultArgs' apply when -Args is not given. 'noUserSite: true' runs python with -s and PYTHONNOUSERSITE=1 (required by the mtsd-attrcls environment). Intentionally excluded: MDWD YOLO11 training (completed historical EUVIP runs under Results/MDWD-Runs/YOLO11-EUVIP; its notebook predates the current convention and no runnable interface remains) - MTSD YOLO11 is covered by the canonical 13-model matrix.

MDWD-EDA.description: Full MDWD exploratory data analysis (tables + figures to Documents/MDWD-EDA).

MDWD-EDA-Notebook.description: MDWD EDA notebook, executed headlessly to a timestamped copy.

MTSD-EDA.description: MTSD EDA notebook (image inventory, EXIF/GPS, annotation analysis).

MDWD-YOLO12-Notebook.description: MDWD YOLO12 model-scale benchmark - RUNS TRAINING (RUN_TRAINING=True in the notebook).

MDWD-YOLO26-Notebook.description: MDWD YOLO26 model-scale benchmark - RUNS TRAINING.

MTSD-Prepare-Detection-Dataset.description: Builds Datasets/MTSD/Prepared/{MTSD-YOLO,MTSD-COCO} from QA annotations (~2 GB; overwrite-protected internally).

MTSD-Prepare-CLI.description: Canonical MTSD preparation CLI. Default is a read-only annotation/split/model plan.

MTSD-Supervised-Matrix.description: RUNS TRAINING: the resumable 13-model MTSD supervised dissertation matrix (YOLO11/12/26 + RF-DETR).

MTSD-Supervised-Smoke.description: RUNS TRAINING (small): two-epoch YOLO12n + RF-DETR Nano end-to-end smoke test.

MTSD-Validate-Prepared.description: Strict validation of the prepared MTSD dataset variants (YOLO/COCO layouts, split integrity, hash leakage, class support). Read-only; fails when no prepared dataset exists yet.

MTSD-Dataset-Audit.description: Read-only MTSD dataset-pipeline state audit: group discovery, vocabulary consistency, scope vs QA gate reconciliation, attribute-manifest cross-check, prepared-dataset status. Default prints only; drop --dry-run via -Args to write the timestamped JSON+MD report.

MTSD-Aug-Ablation.description: RUNS TRAINING: MTSD augmentation-ablation arm on the UNAUGMENTED variant (YOLO11m/12m/26m). The augmented arm of the ablation reuses the dissertation-matrix runs on MTSD-Augmented.

MTSD-Refresh-QA-Gate.description: Discovers current Final-QA groups and the newest annotation-QA audit, then reports (or, with --apply, writes) the refreshed approved_groups scope and qa_gate.yaml resolution status. Never prepares data, trains, or runs the audit itself.

MTSD-YOLO12-Notebook.description: MTSD YOLO12 benchmark - training notebook (ships with RUN_TRAINING=False; flip it before a real run).

MTSD-YOLO26-Notebook.description: MTSD YOLO26 benchmark - training notebook (RUN_TRAINING=False by default).

MTSD-RFDETR-Notebook.description: MTSD RF-DETR benchmark - training notebook (RUN_TRAINING=False by default).

PromptDetect-App.description: Launches the interactive PromptDetect Gradio app (long-running server; stop with Ctrl+C).

PromptDetect-BatchEval.description: PromptDetect batch evaluation. Default args are a safe dry-run; pass -Args for a real run.

MTSD-AnnotationQA-Review-UI.description: Local web app for reviewing the latest annotation audit (saves review decisions only, never edits annotation JSON). Long-running server; stop with Ctrl+C.

MTSD-AnnotationQA-Apply-Preview.description: Preview what the latest review decisions would change (dry run; annotations untouched). A real apply requires -Args '--decisions latest --apply' and the tool's own confirmations.

PromptDetect-Dissertation-Plan.description: Validate the fixed targeted-v1 PromptDetect dissertation protocol for MDWD+MTSD without loading models (read-only plan).

PromptDetect-Dissertation-MDWD.description: Fixed targeted-v1 PromptDetect dissertation protocol for MDWD (loads heavy inference models).

PromptDetect-Dissertation-MTSD.description: Fixed targeted-v1 PromptDetect dissertation protocol for prepared MTSD (loads heavy inference models).

GDPR-Compliance.description: GDPR redaction tool. Default shows help (its 'preview' loads SAM 3.1); e.g. -Args 'preview --limit 5 --backend classic'.

Inference-Benchmark.description: Deployment/inference-speed benchmark. Default lists the model inventory; pass -Args for a benchmark run.

MTSD-AnnotationQA-Scan.description: Read-only MTSD annotation audit (writes a timestamped report folder).

Final-Dataset-Integrity.description: Dissertation-ready dataset integrity report for MDWD + MTSD (read-only).

Export-Dissertation-Tables.description: Consolidates existing result files into Documents/Final-Tables (timestamped).

MDWD-Leakage-Sensitivity.description: MDWD split-leakage sensitivity report (audit-only by default; pass -Args '--run-inference --models best-per-family' to re-evaluate checkpoints on leakage-clean valid/test subsets).

Robustness-Slices.description: Robustness slice analysis over stored predictions (no inference). Default is a dry-run; drop --dry-run via -Args to write the timestamped report + figures.

Annotation-Effort.description: Annotation/training/operational effort report (read-only sources; manual hours from config/annotation_effort_manual.yaml). Default is a dry-run.

Bootstrap-Uncertainty.description: Bootstrap CIs / paired comparisons over stored sample-level outcomes (no inference). Default is a dry-run.

Dissertation-Dashboard.description: Builds the static offline dissertation evidence dashboard (viewer only - never trains or runs inference).

Failure-Case-Sampler.description: Error-analysis image sampler (FP/FN/duplicate/low-conf). Needs -Args, e.g. '--dataset PromptDetect --latest'.

AttrCls-List-Variants.description: List every configured MTSD attribute-classifier variant (DINOv3, V-JEPA 2.1, ConvNeXt, LingBot-Vision; sizes and adaptations) with metadata. Read-only.

AttrCls-Plan.description: Resolved 16-variant size-ablation experiment plan (read-only: no manifest refresh, no model loading, no training).

AttrCls-Size-Ablation-Frozen.description: TRAINS the 8 frozen linear-probe size-ablation variants (all four backbone families, base+large).

AttrCls-Size-Ablation-Adapted.description: TRAINS the 8 adapted size-ablation variants (LoRA for the SSL backbones, full fine-tuning for ConvNeXt).

AttrCls-Size-Ablation-All.description: TRAINS the complete 16-variant size-ablation matrix and writes the consolidated reports.

AttrCls-Smoke.description: One-variant end-to-end smoke test (tiny subset, 1 epoch, W&B disabled, checkpoints under *-smoke). Gated because it refreshes the manifest and loads a model.

AttrCls-Compare-UI.description: Local web app comparing trained attribute-classifier checkpoints side by side (all four families, any size/adaptation). Long-running server; stop with Ctrl+C.
